record.nameMeaning: "Opening lizard", for the openings in its frill
record.oneLiner: A ceratopsian with a large, fenestrated neck frill.
record.description: Chasmosaurus was a mid-sized chasmosaurine horned dinosaur of Late Cretaceous Alberta, 4.3–4.8 m long, named for the large openings (fenestrae) in its neck frill. Many specimens come from Dinosaur Provincial Park.

notableFacts.text: Its large neck frill was lightened by big openings (fenestrae).
